title: Calculus II
audience: a college student in a mathematics degree program (or a related major such as physics, computer science or economics), or an adult studying the same material on their own
purpose: Select integration methods and convergence tests and use series to control approximation error.

blocks.deliverable: Compare two possible integration methods on the same example.
Solve mixed integrals and check by differentiating.
Decide convergence before evaluating; compute a volume or arc length.
Week 7 midterm; test convergent and divergent examples.
Determine an interval of convergence including endpoints.
Calculate a bound and compare with numerical error.
Submit the approximation report and a 120 minute final.

project: Approximate a physical function by a Taylor polynomial and quantify the error on a stated interval.
completion: finish the project, take the week 7 midterm and week 14 cumulative final, then complete a new cumulative assessment after 1 to 2 weeks. Explain one major result aloud without notes.
